systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Coaxial Electrohydrodynamic Cold Atomization & Encapsulation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Sanitary Electrohydrodynamic Encapsulation Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 170.36 GRAS / FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / IEEE Std 510 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 60-01 / ISO 14644-1 Class 7)
systemArchitectures.technology: Multi-Capillary Coaxial Taylor Cone-Jet Electrohydrodynamic Atomization System (12–28 kV DC regulated high-voltage generator, solid-state ripple <0.05%, 32–128 needle linear manifold), Dual Precision Sanitary Syringe/Pulse-Free Micro-Gear Pumps (0.1–50 mL/h per nozzle), In-Line Grounded Crosslinking Collection Bath with Continuous Hydrodynamic Overflow, and Closed-Loop HEPA-Filtered Dry Nitrogen Enclosure
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished Solid 316L Stainless Steel Coaxial Needles (Inner ID 0.26 mm, Outer ID 0.84 mm, Ra ≤ 0.20 µm), PEEK Insulator Manifolds, Platinum Ground Electrodes, and USP Class VI FFKM Kalrez Seals
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: IEEE Std 510 Ultra-Fast Optical Arc-Quench Crowbar (<1.0 µs trip time), Redundant Earth Grounding Continuity Loop (<0.1 Ohm), Interlocked Polycarbonate Faraday Enclosure, and Oxygen Depletion Gas Sensors
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship commercial continuous electrohydrodynamic encapsulation system operating in the stable Taylor cone-jet regime. Atomizes core-shell micro-droplets at ambient temperature using purely electrostatic coulombic forces, eliminating thermal degradation and shear stress for living probiotic cells and polyunsaturated omega-3 oils.

systemArchitectures.name: Aseptic Cleanroom Pharmaceutical Probiotic & Biotherapeutic Nano-Encapsulator
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Micro-Encapsulation Skid (ISO 14644-1 Class 5 / EU GMP Annex 1 / USP <467> / USP <1788> / FDA 21 CFR § 211)
systemArchitectures.technology: Hermetic Class A Laminar Flow Coaxial Electrospray Chamber with Micro-Fluidic Ceramic Emitter Array, Closed-Loop In-Line Calcium Alginate Gelling Reactor with Continuous Ultrasonic Micro-Sieve Harvest, and HEPA-14 Sterile Nitrogen Recirculation
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Mirror-Polished 316L Stainless Steel with High-Purity Fused Silica Core Nozzle and Gold-Coated Discharge Ring (Ra ≤ 0.10 µm), FDA Silicone & PTFE Sanitary O-Rings
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: High-Voltage Fast Shutoff (<0.8 µs), Class 5 Interlocked Enclosure, Real-Time Aerosol Optical Particle Counter, and Dual Earth Bonding Verification
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for biopharmaceutical and medical-grade enteric probiotic delivery, oral peptide vaccines, and bioactive monoclonal antibody preservation. Delivers monodisperse sub-10-micron core-shell capsules with near-100% cell survival and total gastric acid protection (pH 2.0 bypass).

systemArchitectures.name: Industrial High-Throughput Lipidic Omega-3 & Carotenoid Micro-Encapsulation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Commercial High-Throughput Food Ingredient Encapsulation Skid (FSSC 22000 / USDA Certified Biobased / ASME B31.3 / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: Dual-Row 128-Capillary Coaxial Manifold with High-Speed Pneumatically Shrouded EHD Nozzles, Direct Low-Temperature Solidification Column, Continuous Fluidized Powder Collection Cyclone, and In-Line Nitrogen Inerting (O2 < 0.5%)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: 316L Stainless Steel Shell with Tungsten Carbide Needle Tips and Conductive Fluoropolymer Liquid Lines
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Automatic Gas Purge Interlock (N2 blanket mandatory for operation), Spark Detection and Extinction Loop, ASME Pressure Relieving Valves on Liquid Feeds
systemArchitectures.description: Designed for bulk commercial food fortification with high-potency EPA/DHA marine fish oils, algal oils, and astaxanthin oleoresins. Creates impermeable plant-protein or modified starch shells that shield vulnerable double bonds against oxidative rancidity without heating.

systemArchitectures.name: Analytical Benchtop Coaxial EHD-CME Pilot Research Rig
systemArchitectures.classification: Laboratory & Pilot Scale Testing System (ISO 9001 / CE / UL 61010-1)
systemArchitectures.technology: Precision Optical Coaxial EHD Emitter with Micrometer Z-Stage (30–250 mm working distance), High-Speed CMOS Stroboscopic Meniscus Camera (50,000 fps), and Dual Channel High-Precision Syringe Dispenser (0.01–100 mL/h)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Passivated 316L Stainless Steel, PEEK Core Holders, Optical Quartz Observation Chamber
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Interlocked Acrylic Protective Enclosure, Keyed Emergency Stop, and Microsecond High-Voltage Trip
systemArchitectures.description: Analytical benchtop platform for mapping Taylor cone-jet stability boundaries, optimizing electrical conductivity/viscosity ratios (σ_core / σ_shell), and calculating live cell survival curves across experimental biopolymer shells.

encapsulationFormulations.name: Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG in Sodium Alginate / Whey Protein Isolate (WPI) Shell
encapsulationFormulations.coreMaterial: Live Probiotic Bacterial Culture (Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG, 10^10 CFU/mL in saline peptone buffer)
encapsulationFormulations.shellMaterial: Food-Grade Sodium Alginate (1.8% w/v) + Whey Protein Isolate (WPI 4.0% w/v) Matrix
encapsulationFormulations.description: High-value probiotic formulation designed for targeted intestinal release. In simulated gastric fluid (pH 2.0, pepsin, 2h), the alginate-WPI composite shell contracts into an acid-insoluble hydrogel shield, protecting 94.2% of viable CFU. In simulated intestinal fluid (pH 7.4, pancreatin), the calcium ions exchange with phosphate, rapidly dissolving the shell to release intact live bacteria.

encapsulationFormulations.name: Algal EPA/DHA Omega-3 Oil in Whey Protein / Hydrolyzed Maltodextrin Shell
encapsulationFormulations.coreMaterial: Pure Algal Long-Chain Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids (45% DHA, 15% EPA, zero solvent oleoresin)
encapsulationFormulations.shellMaterial: Crosslinked Whey Protein Isolate (WPI 6.0% w/v) + High-DE Maltodextrin (12.0% w/v) + Sodium Caseinate (2.0%)
encapsulationFormulations.description: Shields sensitive conjugated double bonds of polyunsaturated fatty acids from thermal oxygen exposure. In conventional thermal spray drying (inlet 180°C), lipid hydroperoxides surge, creating fishy off-flavors and cytotoxic aldehydes. Room-temperature EHD-CME locks the core in an oxygen-impermeable vitreous protein-sugar shell, keeping peroxide value below 0.8 meq/kg for over 8 months.

encapsulationFormulations.name: Thermolabile Superoxide Dismutase (SOD) & Lactase in Chitosan / Citrus Pectin Shell
encapsulationFormulations.coreMaterial: Native Enzymatic Superoxide Dismutase (SOD) & Bioactive Beta-Galactosidase
encapsulationFormulations.shellMaterial: Medical-Grade Chitosan (1.2% w/v) + Low-Methoxyl Citrus Pectin (2.5% w/v) Polyelectrolyte Complex
encapsulationFormulations.description: Formulation for sensitive antioxidant enzymes that undergo irreversible quaternary conformation loss at temperatures above 42°C. EHD-CME generates monodisperse poly-electrolyte complex core-shell microcapsules that shield the enzymatic active site through gastric passage and deliver >98% enzymatic catalytic activity in the small intestine.

encapsulationFormulations.name: Conventional High-Temperature Spray Drying Hazard Benchmark (Thermal Injury)
encapsulationFormulations.coreMaterial: Probiotic Culture / Omega-3 Slurry subjected to hot drying air (Inlet 175°C, Outlet 82°C)
encapsulationFormulations.shellMaterial: Maltodextrin / Gum Arabic carrier subjected to rapid thermal dehydration
encapsulationFormulations.description: Negative benchmark demonstrating the catastrophic consequences of thermal spray drying on thermolabile biotics. High thermal gradients (ΔT > 150°C) cause extensive bacterial membrane lipid peroxidation, protein ribosome denaturation, and loss of 2–3 log CFU viability, accompanied by severe rancidity.

encapsulationFormulations.name: Conventional Toxic Chemical Crosslinking Hazard Benchmark (Glutaraldehyde Residue)
encapsulationFormulations.coreMaterial: Bioactive Extract crosslinked using dialdehydes (Glutaraldehyde / Formaldehyde / Genipin)
encapsulationFormulations.shellMaterial: Gelatin matrix hardened with 0.5% glutaraldehyde chemical crosslinker
encapsulationFormulations.description: Hazardous industry practice utilizing dialdehyde chemical crosslinkers. Glutaraldehyde residues (>50 ppm) violate USP <467> and FDA food contact thresholds, directly crosslinking bacterial cell walls and killing live probiotic cultures while creating chronic cytotoxicity risks.

variables.τ_electric: Normal electrostatic surface stress at liquid meniscus (N/m²)
variables.E: Applied electric field intensity at capillary tip (V/m)
variables.γ: Surface tension of outer shell liquid (N/m)
variables.r_meniscus: Radius of curvature of the Taylor cone apex (m)

taylorConeStressEquilibrium.significance: Establishes the fundamental balance where normal electrostatic repulsion overcomes surface tension, transforming the spherical liquid meniscus into a conical Taylor cone that emits a stable, sub-micron electrified jet.

criticalTaylorVoltage.equation: V_c = sqrt((2 · γ · r_c · ln(4H / r_c)) / ε_0)

variables.V_c: Critical onset voltage required for Taylor cone formation (V)
variables.γ: Surface tension of the outer shell fluid (N/m)
variables.r_c: Outer radius of the emitter capillary (m)
variables.H: Working distance from capillary tip to grounded collector (m)

criticalTaylorVoltage.significance: Defines the exact minimum high-voltage potential needed to trigger the transition from pulsating droplet dripping to the steady cone-jet regime without corona discharge or sparking.

variables.d_p: Mean diameter of resulting core-shell microcapsules (m)
variables.ρ: Bulk density of the liquid formulation (kg/m³)
variables.Q_total: Combined volumetric flow rate of core + shell fluids (m³/s)
variables.σ_e: Electrical conductivity of the outer shell fluid (S/m)

scalingLawDropletDiameter.significance: Proves that droplet size in the EHD cone-jet regime scales with the 1/6th power of flow rate, enabling precise nanoscale and microscale diameter control (sub-10 µm) with monodisperse distribution (PDI < 0.10).

variables.r_core: Radius of the encapsulated inner active payload core (m)
variables.r_total: Overall outer radius of the complete microcapsule (m)
variables.Q_core: Volumetric injection flow rate of core fluid (mL/h)
variables.Q_shell: Volumetric injection flow rate of shell fluid (mL/h)

coreShellThicknessRatio.significance: Demonstrates that shell wall thickness is directly tuned by adjusting the hydrodynamic pumping ratio between core and shell streams without modifying physical needle geometry.

variables.SEC_ehd: Specific energy consumption of electrohydrodynamic atomization (kJ/kg)
variables.I_current: Total spray electric current (~10 to 500 nA per needle)
variables.FlowRate_mass: Total mass production rate of microcapsules (kg/s)
variables.SEC_thermal: Specific energy consumption of thermal spray drying (~2,800 to 4,500 kJ/kg)
variables.ΔH_vap: Latent heat of water vaporization (2,260 kJ/kg)

specificEnergyRatio.significance: Illustrates why non-thermal Coulombic droplet fission uses less than 10% of the energy consumed by thermal evaporative spray drying, saving >90% in electrical utility expenses.

regulatoryStandards.title: Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) Affirmation for Direct Food Micro-Encapsulates
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Use of natural, food-grade biopolymers (sodium alginate, whey protein, pectin) and ionic crosslinking (calcium chloride) eliminates toxic synthetic aldehydes and qualifies for direct dietary consumption.

regulatoryStandards.title: Current Good Manufacturing Practice & Preventive Controls for Human Food
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Demands sanitary 316L stainless steel / PEEK construction (Ra ≤ 0.4 µm), clean-in-place (CIP) drainability, and zero cross-contamination in continuous food ingredient manufacturing.

regulatoryStandards.title: IEEE Recommended Practices for Safety in High-Voltage Testing & Industrial Systems
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Mandates sub-microsecond optical arc-quench circuits (<1.0 µs trip time), continuous earth ground continuity monitoring (<0.1 Ohm), and interlocked Faraday enclosures.

regulatoryStandards.title: United States Pharmacopeia: Residual Solvents and Sub-Visible Particulate Matter Limits
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Zero volatile organic chemical solvents (0.0 ppm residual hexane/acetone/glutaraldehyde) and elimination of particulate shedding from mechanical grinding media.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Rupture Devices and In-Line Processing Skids
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: All product contact nozzles, manifolds, and collection tanks must be fully drainable, self-cleaning, and free of dead legs or threading in product zones.

regulatoryStandards.title: Cleanrooms and Associated Controlled Environments: Airborne Particulate Cleanliness
regulatoryStandards.complianceRule: Enclosed laminar nitrogen airflow with HEPA-14 filtration guarantees zero airborne bacterial contamination during living probiotic encapsulation.

operationalModes.name: Live Probiotic Enteric Protection & Colon Delivery Mode
operationalModes.description: Optimized for maximum bacterial cell viability. Electrostatically draws a protective concentric shell of alginate-WPI around living cells at 20°C, ensuring high acid stability during stomach transit (pH 2.0) and full dissolution in the small intestine.

operationalModes.name: Zero-Oxidation Lipid & Carotenoid Oxygen-Barrier Mode
operationalModes.targetProduct: Marine EPA/DHA Fish Oil, Algal DHA, Astaxanthin Oleoresin
operationalModes.description: Formulates microcapsules under a continuous dry nitrogen blanket (O2 < 0.2%). Non-thermal atomization prevents free-radical generation and aldehyde formation, delivering crystal-clear odor-free omega-3 powders.

operationalModes.name: Thermolabile Enzyme & Bioactive Protein Preservation Mode
operationalModes.targetProduct: Lactase, Superoxide Dismutase, Proteases, Peptide Bioactives
operationalModes.description: Low-voltage gentle Taylor cone jet designed to maintain 100% native enzyme conformation. Eliminates shear cavitation and thermal shock, delivering >98% active catalytic retention.

operationalModes.name: High-Throughput Commercial Energy-Saver Mode
operationalModes.targetProduct: Functional Food Fortification Powders & Micro-Nutrient Blends
operationalModes.description: Maximized throughput configuration operating across a 256-needle manifold. Produces up to 50 kg/day of premium encapsulated functional food ingredients with 92% lower electrical energy cost than spray drying.
